settings.heading: Packaging for teams that reorder every week.
settings.text: Boxes, tape, film and mailers by the case. Approved accounts get tier pricing, a one-screen reorder grid and Net-30 invoicing.

settings.heading: Case prices that drop as your volume grows.
settings.guest_note: List prices shown. Log in with an approved trade account to see tier prices.

settings.heading: Reorder in under a minute.
settings.text: Type quantities, watch tiers apply per line, add everything in one go. Or load your last order and adjust.

settings.heading: Apply once. Order on terms.
settings.legal: We check your business details and reply within one business day. No credit check for prepaid accounts.
settings.success_text: Our trade desk reviews new accounts within one business day. You'll get an email when your pricing is live.

settings.title: Apply in two minutes
settings.text: Company, tax ID and rough monthly spend. That's it.

settings.title: Reviewed by a human
settings.text: Your application lands in our CRM; most are approved the same day.

settings.title: Tier pricing unlocks
settings.text: Log in and every price on the site switches to your trade rate.

settings.title: Order on Net-30
settings.text: Invoice payment terms after your first three orders.

settings.heading: Trade questions
settings.text: Our trade desk answers by email within four business hours.

settings.question: How do tier prices work?
settings.answer: Each SKU has case prices for 1–9, 10–49 and 50+ cases. The tier is set per line, per order, and applied automatically at checkout.

settings.question: What do I need to apply?
settings.answer: A registered business, a tax ID where applicable and a delivery address. Hospitality groups can add multiple sites after approval.

settings.question: When can I pay on Net-30?
settings.answer: After three paid orders we offer invoice terms up to a limit agreed with your account manager.

settings.question: Do you deliver by pallet?
settings.answer: Orders over 40 cases ship on a pallet with a 1-hour delivery window. Smaller orders go by courier, next day.
